segments.an9.38:1.1: Atha kho dve lokāyatikā brāhmaṇā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu.
segments.an9.38:1.2: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te brāhmaṇā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.an9.38:2.1: “Pūraṇo, bho gotama, kassapo sabbaññū sabbadassāvī aparisesaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paṭijānāti –
segments.an9.38:2.2: ‘carato ca me tiṭṭhato ca suttassa ca jāgarassa ca satataṃ samitaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paccupaṭṭhitan’ti.
segments.an9.38:2.4: ‘ahaṃ anantena ñāṇena anantaṃ lokaṃ jānaṃ passaṃ viharāmī’ti.
segments.an9.38:2.5: Ayampi [ayampi hi (syā. ka.)], bho gotama, nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto sabbaññū sabbadassāvī aparisesaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paṭijānāti –
segments.an9.38:2.6: ‘carato ca me tiṭṭhato ca suttassa ca jāgarassa ca satataṃ samitaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paccupaṭṭhitan’ti.
segments.an9.38:2.8: ‘ahaṃ anantena ñāṇena anantaṃ lokaṃ jānaṃ passaṃ viharāmī’ti.
segments.an9.38:2.9: Imesaṃ, bho gotama, ubhinnaṃ ñāṇavādānaṃ ubhinnaṃ aññamaññaṃ vipaccanīkavādānaṃ ko saccaṃ āha ko musā”ti?
segments.an9.38:3.3: ‘imesaṃ ubhinnaṃ ñāṇavādānaṃ ubhinnaṃ aññamaññaṃ vipaccanīkavādānaṃ ko saccaṃ āha ko musā’ti.
segments.an9.38:3.5: taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha; bhāsissāmī”ti.
segments.an9.38:3.6: “Evaṃ, bho”ti kho te brāhmaṇā bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
segments.an9.38:4.1: “Seyyathāpi, brāhmaṇā, cattāro purisā catuddisā ṭhitā paramena javena ca samannāgatā paramena ca padavītihārena.
segments.an9.38:4.2: Te evarūpena javena samannāgatā assu, seyyathāpi nāma daḷhadhammā [daḷhadhammo (sabbattha) a. ni.4.45; ma. ni.1.116 ca, taṃsaṃvaṇṇanāṭīkāyo ca moggallānabyākaraṇañca oloketabbā] dhanuggaho sikkhito katahattho katūpāsano lahukena asanena appakasirena tiriyaṃ tālacchāyaṃ [tālacchātiṃ (sī. syā. pī.), tālacchādiṃ (ka.) a. ni.4.45; ma. ni.1.161 passitabbaṃ] atipāteyya;
segments.an9.38:4.3: evarūpena ca padavītihārena, seyyathāpi nāma puratthimā samuddā pacchimo samuddo
segments.an9.38:4.4: atha puratthimāya disāya ṭhito puriso evaṃ vadeyya –
segments.an9.38:4.6: So aññatreva asitapītakhāyitasāyitā aññatra uccārapassāvakammā aññatra niddākilamathapaṭivinodanā vassasatāyuko vassasatajīvī vassasataṃ gantvā appatvāva lokassa antaṃ antarā kālaṃ kareyya.
segments.an9.38:4.9: atha dakkhiṇāya disāya ṭhito puriso evaṃ vadeyya –
segments.an9.38:4.11: So aññatreva asitapītakhāyitasāyitā aññatra uccārapassāvakammā aññatra niddākilamathapaṭivinodanā vassasatāyuko vassasatajīvī vassasataṃ gantvā appatvāva lokassa antaṃ antarā kālaṃ kareyya.
segments.an9.38:4.13: Nāhaṃ, brāhmaṇā, evarūpāya sandhāvanikāya lokassa antaṃ ñāteyyaṃ daṭṭheyyaṃ patteyyanti vadāmi.
segments.an9.38:4.14: Na cāhaṃ, brāhmaṇā, appatvāva lokassa antaṃ dukkhassa antakiriyaṃ vadāmi.
segments.an9.38:5.1: “Pañcime, brāhmaṇā, kāmaguṇā ariyassa vinaye lokoti vuccati.
segments.an9.38:5.3: Cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā;
segments.an9.38:5.7: kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā;
segments.an9.38:5.8: ime kho, brāhmaṇā, pañca kāmaguṇā ariyassa vinaye lokoti vuccati.
segments.an9.38:6.1: “Idha, brāhmaṇā, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.an9.38:6.2: Ayaṃ vuccati, brāhmaṇā,‘bhikkhu lokassa antamāgamma, lokassa ante viharati’.
segments.an9.38:6.5: Ahampi hi [ahampi (sī. pī.)], brāhmaṇā, evaṃ vadāmi –
segments.an9.38:7.1: “Puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇā, bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā … pe … dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ …
segments.an9.38:7.4: Ayaṃ vuccati, brāhmaṇā,‘bhikkhu lokassa antamāgamma lokassa ante viharati’.
segments.an9.38:8.1: “Puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇā, bhikkhu sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ‘ananto ākāso’ti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.an9.38:8.2: Ayaṃ vuccati, brāhmaṇā,‘bhikkhu lokassa antamāgamma lokassa ante viharati’.
segments.an9.38:9.1: “Puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇā, bhikkhu sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘anantaṃ viññāṇan’ti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati … pe …
segments.an9.38:9.2: sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘natthi kiñcī’ti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati … pe …
segments.an9.38:9.3: sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.an9.38:9.4: Ayaṃ vuccati, brāhmaṇā,‘bhikkhu lokassa antamāgamma lokassa ante viharati’.
segments.an9.38:10.1: “Puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇā, bhikkhu sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati, paññāya cassa disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā honti.
segments.an9.38:10.2: Ayaṃ vuccati, brāhmaṇā,‘bhikkhu lokassa antamāgamma lokassa ante viharati tiṇṇo loke visattikan’”ti.

lines: Tiṭṭhatetanti tiṭṭhatu etaṃ, mā etaṃ paṭṭhapetha, ko vo etena attho.
Dhammaṃ vo brāhmaṇā desessāmīti ahaṃ vo catusaccadhammaṃ desessāmi.
Dvisahassathāmaṃ nāma yassa āropitassa jiyābaddho lohasīsādīnaṃ bhāro daṇḍe gahetvā yāva kaṇḍappamāṇā ukkhittassa pathavito muccati.
Katahatthoti eko sippameva uggaṇhāti, katahattho na hoti ayaṃ pana katahattho ciṇṇavasibhāvo.
Lahukena asanenāti anto susiraṃ katvā tūlādīhi pūretvā katalakkhaparikammena sallahukakaṇḍena.
Evaṃ katañhi ekausabhagāmī dve usabhānipi gacchati … pe … aṭṭhusabhagāmī soḷasa usabhānipi gacchati.
Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – yathā so dhanuggaho taṃ vidatthicaturaṅgulaṃ chāyaṃ sīghameva atikkāmeti, evaṃ sakalacakkavāḷaṃ sīghaṃ sīghaṃ atikkamanasamatthena javena samannāgato.
Daḷhaṃ thiraṃ dhanu etassāti daḷhadhanvā (a. ni. ṭī.2.4.45-46; saṃ. ni. ṭī.1.1.107), so eva “daḷhadhammā”ti vutto.
So eva usuṃ saraṃ asati khipatīti issāso.
Yāva kaṇḍappamāṇāti dīghato yattakaṃ kaṇḍassa pamāṇaṃ, tattake dhanudaṇḍe ukkhittamatte āropitesuyeva jiyādaṇḍesu so ce bhāro pathavito muccati, evaṃ idaṃ dvisahassathāmaṃ nāma dhanūti daṭṭhabbaṃ.
Īdiso pana tattha vasibhūto katahattho nāma hotīti āha “ciṇṇavasibhāvo”ti.
Kataṃ rājakulādīsu upecca asanaṃ etena so katūpāsanoti āha “rājakulādīsu dassitasippo”ti.
Sattame lokāyatavādakāti āyatiṃ hitaṃ loko na yatati na viruhati etenāti lokāyataṃ, vitaṇḍasatthaṃ.
Tañhi ganthaṃ nissāya sattā puññakiriyāya cittampi na uppādenti, taṃ vadantīti lokāyatavādakā.
